name: Monstergirl Mansion
source:
Monstergirl Mansion is a visual novel about a community of monstergirls taking care of their own. You are a monstergirl who needs a safe place to stay, and this is a place that's guaranteed to take you in. You can meet and romance all three of the mansion's caretakers over the course of your first three days at the mansion.

[From [url=https://krinndnz.itch.io/monstergirl-mansion]itch.io[/url]]

Created for [url=https://itch.io/jam/strawberry-jam]Strawberry Jam[/url].
translation:
《怪物娘庄园》是一部视觉小说，讲述怪物娘组成社群、互相照顾的故事。你是一名需要安全住所的怪物娘，而这里保证会接纳你。在庄园度过的前三天里，你可以与三名照料者见面并发展恋爱关系。

[来源：[url=https://krinndnz.itch.io/monstergirl-mansion]itch.io[/url]]

本作为[url=https://itch.io/jam/strawberry-jam]Strawberry Jam[/url]创作。
